question: Which among the following instruments is used to measure the humidity of the air or a gas?
solution:
The correct answer is a __**Hygrometer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A hygrometer is an instrument used to measure the amount of water vapor or humidity in the air or gas.
 
 
• There are different types of hygrometers, such as mechanical, electrical, and digital, that use different principles to measure humidity.
 
• **A hygrometer is an instrument used to measure relative humidity**.
 
 
• A** psychrometer **is an example of a hygrometer.
 
• A **psychrometer uses two thermometers to measure relative humidity,** one measures the dry-bulb temperature, and the other measures the wet-bulb temperature.
 
 
 
• **Humidity is the measure of the amount of moisture in the air.**
 
 
 
• **Anemometer,** on the other hand, is an instrument used to measure **wind speed and direction.**
 
• ** A bolometer** is an instrument used to measure** electromagnetic radiation, such as infrared or microwave radiation.**
 
• ** A hydrometer **is an instrument used to measure the** density or specific gravity of liquids**.
 
 
• Hydrometer operates based on the Archimedes principle that a solid body displaces its own weight within a liquid in which it floats.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 **INSTRUMENT**
 **MEASUREMENT**
 
 

 Hydrometer
 Specific gravity or density of a liquid.
 
 

 Pyrometer
 Temperature.
 
 

 Lactometer
 Amount of water in the milk or purity of milk.
